title: Regression predicts numbers
summary: Regression is a task that predicts a number. Here we supply a doubling rule ourselves so the calculation is easy to inspect.
introduction: Regression is a task that predicts a number. Here we supply a doubling rule ourselves so the calculation is easy to inspect. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Regression is a task that predicts a number. Here we supply a doubling rule ourselves so the calculation is easy to inspect.
The output is 8 because 2 times 4 is 8. This rule was written by a person; no training happened in this code.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Predict for five pages, then check the calculation.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A hand-written rule is not automatically a learned model.
For more detail later, use this [Machine Learning further reading](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course).
